title: FYI Yachts Sells 2021 62' Explorer and 2011 47' Sea Ray Sundancer
description: FYI Yachts reports successful sales: a 2021 62' Explorer via Lease-to-Own and a 2011 47' Sea Ray Sundancer — showcasing expert yacht sales service.
html:
At FYI Yachts, delivering results for our clients is always the top priority — and our latest sales are a testament to that commitment. We’re excited to share the successful closings of two standout vessels: a 2021 62’ Explorer and a 2011 47’ Sea Ray Sundancer. Each sale highlights the trust owners place in FYI and the expertise our team brings to every transaction.

The 2021 Explorer 62, based in Miami, was sold through FYI’s innovative Lease to Own program, giving the new owner a flexible path into yacht ownership. This sleek and modern yacht is designed for both comfort and performance, featuring four staterooms, Seakeeper 9 stabilization, FLIR night vision, underwater lights, and a spacious cockpit with a unique open layout. With salon doors that slide open to both the aft cockpit and starboard side, the yacht seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor spaces — an ideal platform for entertaining or extended cruising in style.

In addition, FYI successfully brokered the sale of a 2011 47’ Sea Ray Sundancer. This yacht has been meticulously maintained and upgraded, offering exceptional value to her new owners. With Zeus 360-degree pod drives, intuitive joystick docking, twin retractable sunroofs, and an enclosed helm designed for all-weather comfort, the Sundancer combines effortless handling with luxury amenities. Her recent service history, including new bottom paint and fully serviced pods in 2022, made her a smart and ready-to-enjoy acquisition.

Together, these sales showcase FYI’s ability to meet the diverse needs of yacht buyers and sellers alike — from traditional brokerage transactions to pioneering programs like Lease to Own. No matter the path, FYI ensures every client has the expertise, network, and support they need to achieve their goals on the water.

If you want to see a sold sign on your yacht, you have to list with FYI.
